statement.en: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention on content without hiding other experiences.
statement.ja: 他の体験を隠さずcontentへ注意を向けるため、dimmed passthroughを使う。

conditions: Use it in the Shared Space or a Full Space.
Passthrough uses black tint by default and can use a custom tint.

statement.en: You can dim or tint passthrough to draw attention to your content.
statement.ja: コンテンツへ注意を向けるために、パススルーを暗くしたり色を付けたりできる。

conditions: In the Shared Space, subtle dimming or tinting can draw attention without hiding other apps; in a Full Space it can create a more focused experience.
Passthrough is tinted black by default; a custom tint is optional.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows7-10, Immersion and passthrough > Immersion styles: the list explicitly introduces can examples. Correct SHOULD to MAY and restrict the no-other-app-hiding outcome to Shared Space. Current hash83195203b6795a634847496e443c96096290f5bcc4eb47b871399c53b2a3c576.

statement.en: Use mixed immersion in a Full Space for unbounded 3D content blended with passthrough.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでunbounded 3D contentをpassthroughと組み合わせるにはmixed immersionを使う。

conditions: Mixed immersion has no system-defined movement boundary.
Nearby content becomes semi-opaque when a person approaches a physical object.

statement.en: You can use mixed immersion in a Full Space to blend unbounded 3D content with passthrough.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでは、mixed方式を使って、ウインドウに収まらない3Dコンテンツをパススルーと組み合わせられる。

conditions: Mixed immersion does not define the movement boundary used by progressive and full immersion.
When someone approaches a physical object, the system automatically makes nearby virtual content semi-opaque; this is system behavior, not a custom opacity implementation requirement.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows7/13-15, Immersion styles: preserve the optional style capability and system ownership of the proximity response. No boundary does not mean unrestricted physical safety.

statement.en: Use progressive immersion when a custom environment should partially replace passthrough.
statement.ja: custom environmentでpassthroughを部分的に置き換える場合はprogressive immersionを使う。

conditions: Support portrait or landscape content where appropriate.
People adjust immersion within a 120–360 degree default range or a specified custom range.
The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary.

statement.en: You can use progressive immersion in a Full Space to partially replace passthrough with a custom environment.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでは、progressive方式を使って、パススルーの一部を独自の環境に置き換えられる。

conditions: Portrait or landscape content and a custom immersion range are supported options, not required design choices.
People can adjust immersion using the Digital Crown within the default 120- to 360-degree range or a custom range if the app specifies one.
The system automatically defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary when progressive immersion starts.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows7/16-18, Immersion styles: correct SHOULD to MAY for the available style and preserve can options, default/custom OR, units, and system-defined boundary. Digital Crown is explicitly named.

statement.en: Use full immersion for a 360-degree custom environment that completely replaces passthrough.
statement.ja: passthroughを完全に置き換える360-degree custom environmentにはfull immersionを使う。

conditions: The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary when the experience starts.

statement.en: You can use full immersion in a Full Space for a 360-degree custom environment that completely replaces passthrough.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでは、full方式を使って、パススルーを完全に置き換える360度の独自環境を表示できる。

conditions: The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary when the fully immersive experience starts.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows7/19-21, Immersion styles: correct SHOULD to MAY for this available style; complete replacement and the boundary are capability descriptions, not a requirement to make every experience fully immersive.

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game.
statement.ja: immersive appやgameに複数の利用方法を用意する。

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game.
statement.ja: 没入型のアプリやゲームには、複数の利用方法を用意する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row32, Best practices: preserve SHOULD for offering multiple ways and the accessibility-support condition; explicit accessibility context supports priority2.

statement.en: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion.
statement.ja: Shared Spaceまたはmixed immersionでの起動を優先する。

conditions: Preserve switching among running experiences.
Let people choose when to increase immersion.

statement.en: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion.
statement.ja: 起動時はShared Space、またはmixed方式の没入を優先する。

conditions: Launching in Shared Space supports using and switching among other running apps.
For an app offering progressive or full immersion, starting in mixed immersion or a Shared Space window lets people choose when to increase immersion.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row34, Best practices: preserve launch alternatives and scope Shared Space multitasking behavior correctly; user choice over increasing immersion supports priority3.

statement.en: Help people engage with key moments at every level of immersion.
statement.ja: immersion levelにかかわらず、key momentへ利用者の注意を導く。

conditions: Start with subtle cues and strengthen them only for a documented reason.
Cues can include dimming, tinting, motion, scale, and Spatial Audio.

statement.en: Help people engage with key moments at every level of immersion.
statement.ja: 没入の度合いにかかわらず、体験の重要な場面に注意を向けられるようにする。

conditions: Start with subtle cues and strengthen them only when there is a good reason.
Dimming, tinting, motion, scale, and Spatial Audio are possible cues, not a required complete set.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row38, Best practices: remove the invented documented-reason requirement; the source asks for a good reason, not a documentation artifact.

statement.en: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors in visionOS 2 and later.
statement.ja: visionOS 2以降ではsubtleなpassthrough tint colorを優先する。

conditions: Coordinate surroundings and visible hands with the experience.
exceptions: Avoid bright or dramatic tints that distract people or reduce immersion.

statement.en: When tinting passthrough in visionOS 2 or later, prefer subtle colors.
statement.ja: visionOS 2以降でパススルーに色を付ける場合は、控えめな色を優先する。

conditions: Tinting is optional and can visually coordinate the surroundings and visible hands with the experience.
Avoid bright or dramatic tints that distract people or diminish immersion.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row40, Best practices: make tinting conditional, not mandatory; the bright-tint avoidance reinforces the recommendation and is not an exception.

statement.en: Protect people’s visual comfort in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで利用者のvisual comfortを守る。

statement.en: Protect people's visual comfort in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでは、利用者が視覚的に快適でいられるよう配慮する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row43, Promoting comfort: retain SHOULD and field-of-view placement as a preference; visual comfort supports accessibility priority2.

statement.en: Choose an immersion style that supports the movement people may make.
statement.ja: 利用者が行う可能性のあるmovementに対応するimmersion styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Minor movements include shifting weight, turning, and changing between sitting and standing.
Use mixed immersion when people may move beyond the approximately 1.5-meter boundary.

statement.en: Choose an immersion style that supports the movements people may make during the experience.
statement.ja: 体験中に利用者が行う可能性のある動きに対応した没入方式を選ぶ。

conditions: Minor movements can include shifting weight, turning, or switching between sitting and standing.
If people may need to move beyond the approximately 1.5-meter boundary, avoid progressive or full immersion, or transition back to mixed immersion.
The progressive/full boundary extends from the initial position of the wearer's head; it is not an app-defined travel distance.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows4/45, Promoting comfort: preserve the avoid-or-transition alternative and boundary context. The explicit movement boundary and system interruption are device constraints, priority5, without inferring a separate life-safety claim.

previous.title: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or full immersion

statement.en: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or fully immersive experiences.
statement.ja: progressiveまたはfully immersiveな体験でmovementを求めない。

conditions: Provide interaction methods that work without physical movement.
exceptions: Bring virtual content closer instead of requiring a person to approach it.

current.title: Avoid encouraging movement in progressive or full immersion

statement.en: Avoid encouraging people to move during progressive or fully immersive experiences.
statement.ja: progressive方式やfull方式の没入体験では、利用者に移動を促すことは避ける。

conditions: People may not want to move or may be unable to move because of disability or physical surroundings.
Provide ways to interact without moving; letting people bring an object closer is an example rather than requiring them to approach it.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row47, Promoting comfort: encouraging is broader than the old requiring statement. Stationary interaction is the supported alternative, not an exception; disability access supports priority2.

statement.en: Adopt ARKit when custom content needs information about a person’s surroundings.
statement.ja: custom contentで利用者の周囲情報が必要な場合はARKitを採用する。

conditions: Use surroundings or hand-position data only for the scoped experience.

statement.en: Adopt ARKit when you want to blend custom content with a person's surroundings.
statement.ja: 独自のコンテンツを利用者の周囲の環境と組み合わせたい場合は、ARKitを採用する。

conditions: Examples include integrating virtual content with physical surroundings or using hand positions to inform the experience.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row51, Promoting comfort: restore the wants-to-blend condition and illustrative surroundings/hand-data alternatives; remove unsupported data-use-only wording from this API-selection rule. Permission remains in0030.

statement.en: Design smooth, predictable transitions between immersion styles.
statement.ja: immersion style間をsmoothかつpredictableに遷移させる。

conditions: Use gentle transitions that let people visually track changes.
exceptions: Avoid sudden or jarring transitions that can disorient people.

statement.en: Design smooth, predictable transitions between immersion styles.
statement.ja: 没入方式を切り替えるときは、滑らかで予測しやすい遷移にする。

conditions: Use gentle transitions that let people visually track changes.
Avoid sudden, jarring changes that could disorient people or cause discomfort.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row54, Transitioning between immersive styles: the avoidance supports the transition guidance rather than excepting it; discomfort/disorientation supports priority2.

statement.en: Let people choose when to enter or exit a more immersive experience.
statement.ja: よりimmersiveな体験へ入る時と出る時を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Provide a clear action for entering and exiting immersion.
exceptions: Avoid requiring system controls to reduce immersion.

statement.en: Let people choose when to enter or exit a more immersive experience.
statement.ja: より没入度の高い体験に入る時と、そこから出る時を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Provide a clear action for entering or exiting immersion.
Avoid requiring people to rely on system controls to reduce immersion; the app's controls should support leaving.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row56, Transitioning between immersive styles: retain SHOULD and user control; avoidance of system-control dependence is complementary guidance, not an exception.

statement.en: Prefer virtual hands that match familiar positions, gestures, and interactions.
statement.ja: familiarな位置、gesture、interactionに一致するvirtual handsを優先する。

conditions: Support natural interaction and sustained immersion in virtual worlds.

statement.en: Prefer virtual hands with familiar characteristics, such as matching the viewer's hand positions and gestures.
statement.ja: 仮想の手には、利用者の手の位置やジェスチャとの一致など、慣れ親しんだ特徴を持たせることを優先する。

conditions: When representing a person's hands virtually in a Full Space, familiar behavior can support natural interaction and immersion.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows61-62, Displaying virtual hands: matching positions/gestures is a source example; explicit hand interaction supports gesture retrieval and input priority5.

statement.en: Use caution when virtual hands are larger than the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: virtual handsを利用者の手より大きくする場合は注意する。

conditions: Avoid obscuring content or making interaction feel clumsy.
Keep virtual hands proportional to the surrounding space.

statement.en: Use caution when virtual hands are larger than the viewer's hands.
statement.ja: 仮想の手を利用者自身の手より大きくする場合は、慎重に設計する。

conditions: Significantly oversized hands can obscure content, make interaction clumsy, or seem out of proportion and too close to the viewer's face.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row64, Displaying virtual hands: preserve caution rather than imposing an absolute size/proportion restriction; content visibility and uncomfortable proximity support priority2.

statement.en: Minimize environmental content that distracts from the primary task.
statement.ja: primary taskから注意をそらすenvironmental contentを最小限にする。

conditions: Avoid excessive movement and high-contrast detail around primary content.
Use higher-quality assets in important areas and quieter assets elsewhere.

statement.en: Minimize environmental content that distracts from the primary task.
statement.ja: 主な作業から注意をそらすような、周囲の環境の表現を抑える。

conditions: To support a primary task such as watching video, avoid excessive movement or high-contrast detail in the environment.
When drawing attention to selected areas, consider higher-quality textures and shapes there, with lower-quality assets or dimming in less important areas; this is an optional technique.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row70, Creating an environment: restore the purpose-dependent alternative and consider qualifier instead of mandating different asset qualities everywhere.

statement.en: Help people distinguish interactive objects in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでinteractive objectを判別できるようにする。

conditions: Use object proximity to support expectations about reach and interaction.

statement.en: Help people distinguish interactive objects in a custom environment.
statement.ja: 独自の環境の中で、操作できるオブジェクトを利用者が見分けられるようにする。

conditions: Object proximity influences expectations: people are more likely to try interacting with nearby objects than distant ones.
This observation does not require using proximity as the sole interactivity cue or encouraging physical movement.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row72, Creating an environment: the near/far examples explain expectations, not a prescribed interaction distance or exclusive visual technique.

statement.en: Keep animation in a custom environment small and gentle.
statement.ja: custom environmentのanimationをsmallかつgentleに保つ。

conditions: Enrich the environment without distracting people or causing discomfort.

statement.en: Keep animation in a custom environment subtle.
statement.ja: 独自の環境のアニメーションは、控えめなものにする。

conditions: Small, gentle movement can enrich an environment without distraction or discomfort; clouds are an example, not required scenery.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row74, Creating an environment: preserve SHOULD and the subtle-animation preference; discomfort prevention supports priority2.

statement.en: Create an expansive custom environment regardless of the place it depicts.
statement.ja: 描く場所にかかわらずexpansiveなcustom environmentを作る。

statement.en: Create an expansive custom environment regardless of the place it depicts.
statement.ja: どのような場所を表現する場合でも、広がりを感じられる独自の環境を作る。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row76, Creating an environment: restrictive spaces can cause discomfort or claustrophobia, supporting priority2; expansive does not specify a measured minimum room size.

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to create atmosphere in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentのatmosphereを作るためSpatial Audioを使う。

conditions: Avoid excessive repetition or looping in the soundscape.

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to create atmosphere in a custom environment.
statement.ja: 独自の環境の雰囲気を作るために、空間オーディオを活用する。

conditions: When designing an environmental soundscape, avoid excessive repetition or looping.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row78, Creating an environment: retain SHOULD and the soundscape context; audio output does not imply voice input.

statement.en: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentで利用者がgroundedだと感じられるようにする。

conditions: Use a ground plane to provide a stable spatial reference.

statement.en: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment.
statement.ja: 独自の環境の中で、利用者が地面に接しているように感じられるようにする。

conditions: A ground-plane mesh provides a stable spatial reference so people do not feel as though they are floating.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row82, Creating an environment: retain the general grounding SHOULD; the explicit mesh MUST is separately retained in0035.

statement.en: Minimize repeated assets and models in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでassetやmodelの繰り返しを最小限にする。

statement.en: Minimize excessive reuse of the same assets and models in a custom environment.
statement.ja: 独自の環境では、同じ素材やモデルの過剰な繰り返しを抑える。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row84, Creating an environment: focus on too-frequent reuse that reduces realism, not a prohibition on all asset reuse. Retain platform-specific priority4.

statement.en: Avoid using a flat 360-degree image as a visionOS environment.
statement.ja: visionOSのenvironmentには、flatな360-degree画像を使わない。

conditions: Prefer object meshes with lighting and shaders for subtle environmental animation.
exceptions: If a flat 360-degree image is necessary, add a ground-plane mesh to improve realism and grounding.

statement.en: In general, avoid using a flat 360-degree image to create a visionOS environment.
statement.ja: 通常は、visionOSの環境を作るために平面的な360度画像を使うことは避ける。

conditions: Prefer lit object meshes and shaders for subtle environmental animation.
exceptions: A flat 360-degree image may be necessary; retain a ground-plane mesh in that case, which can improve realism.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Rows80/82, Creating an environment: restore In general and the explicit flat-image fallback without treating fallback realism as an exception to the ground-plane MUST.

statement.en: Reserve immersion for meaningful tasks, moments, and content.
statement.ja: immersionをmeaningfulなtask、moment、contentに限定する。

conditions: Keep tasks in the Shared Space when immersion adds little value.
Let people remain aware of surroundings and other software when appropriate.

statement.en: Reserve immersion for meaningful tasks, moments, and content.
statement.ja: 没入表現は、その価値がある作業や場面、コンテンツに絞って使う。

conditions: Not every task benefits from immersion, and an immersive task need not be fully immersive.
Design focused opportunities for immersion rather than assuming the experience should be fully immersive most of the time.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row36, Best practices: preserve contextual choice rather than requiring Shared Space for every low-value case; user control over immersive moments supports priority3.

statement.en: When using mixed immersion, avoid obscuring too much passthrough.
statement.ja: mixed immersionではpassthroughを過度に遮らない。

conditions: Preserve enough physical context for people to understand and navigate their surroundings.
exceptions: Use progressive or full immersion when virtual objects must substantially obscure passthrough.

statement.en: When using mixed immersion, avoid obscuring too much passthrough.
statement.ja: mixed方式では、パススルーによる周囲の見え方を過度に遮らないようにする。

conditions: Preserve physical context that helps people understand and navigate their surroundings.
If virtual objects could substantially obscure passthrough, use progressive or full immersion instead of mixed immersion.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row49, Promoting comfort: could substantially obscure is the condition, not only when obstruction is unavoidable. Switching styles is an alternative outside mixed scope, not an exception permitting unsafe mixed obstruction; physical-navigation safety supports priority1.

statement.en: Indicate the purpose of an immersive-experience exit control.
statement.ja: immersive experienceのexit controlが何を行うか示す。

conditions: Differentiate reducing immersion from quitting the experience.
exceptions: Before quitting, consider pause or return controls that let people save progress.

statement.en: Indicate the purpose of an immersive-experience exit control.
statement.ja: 没入体験から出る操作が何を行うのかを示す。

conditions: Differentiate returning to a previous, less immersive context from quitting the experience.
If exiting also quits the app or game, consider controls that let people pause or return somewhere they can save progress before quitting.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row58, Transitioning between immersive styles: pausing or returning to save is a conditional option, not an exception to exit-purpose clarity. Preserve the existing general SHOULD alongside0031's specific MUST.

statement.en: When hand tracking is interrupted, fade virtual hands out and reveal the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: hand trackingが中断したらvirtual handsをfade outし、利用者自身の手を表示する。

statement.en: When hand tracking is interrupted, fade virtual hands out and reveal the viewer's own hands.
statement.ja: 手のトラッキングが中断したら、仮想の手をフェードアウトし、利用者自身の手を見せる。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row66, Displaying virtual hands: retain SHOULD, interruption trigger, and fade-back-on-return condition; explicit hand-tracking lifecycle supports gesture scope and priority5.

statement.en: Display motion in comfortable ways while the experience runs in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで体験を実行するときは、快適な方法でmotionを表示する。

statement.en: Display motion in comfortable ways while the experience runs in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで体験を提供するときは、利用者が不快にならない方法で動きを表示する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row43, Promoting comfort: make sure explicitly supports existing MUST; distraction/confusion/discomfort prevention supports priority2.

statement.en: Request permission before accessing sensitive data about a person’s surroundings or hand positions.
statement.ja: 周囲環境や手の位置に関するsensitive dataへアクセスする前に、permissionを求める。

conditions: The experience uses ARKit data to blend custom content with a person’s surroundings.

statement.en: Request permission before accessing sensitive data about a person's surroundings or hand positions.
statement.ja: 利用者の周囲の環境や手の位置に関する機微なデータへアクセスする前に、許可を求める。

conditions: The experience needs access to sensitive ARKit data, such as surroundings or hand positions, to inform custom content.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row51, Promoting comfort: explicit you must supports existing MUST, conditional on needing sensitive data access; privacy priority3. No new data-access API or consent UI is inferred.

statement.en: Make an exit control clarify whether it reduces immersion or quits the experience.
statement.ja: exit controlがimmersionを下げるのか体験を終了するのかを明確にする。

statement.en: Make an exit control clarify whether it returns to a previous, less immersive context or quits the experience.
statement.ja: 終了操作が、直前の没入度の低い画面へ戻るのか、体験そのものを終了するのかを明確にする。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row58, Transitioning between immersive styles: make sure supports existing MUST and the two explicit outcomes. Restore previous-context detail; outcome clarity supports user-intent priority3.

statement.en: Avoid leaving virtual hands frozen or unresponsive when hand tracking is interrupted.
statement.ja: hand tracking中断時にvirtual handsをfrozenまたはunresponsiveな状態で残さない。

statement.en: Avoid leaving virtual hands frozen or unresponsive when hand tracking is interrupted.
statement.ja: 手のトラッキングが中断したときは、仮想の手を止まったまま、または反応しないまま残すことは避ける。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row66, Displaying virtual hands: preserve Don't as the existing AVOID classification and the reveal-real-hands alternative; explicit tracking failure supports gesture scope and priority5.

statement.en: Do not display excessive movement near the edges of a person’s field of view.
statement.ja: 利用者のfield of viewの端付近に過剰なmovementを表示しない。

statement.en: Do not display excessive movement near the edges of a person's field of view.
statement.ja: 利用者の視野の端付近に、過剰な動きを表示しない。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row74, Creating an environment: explicit Always avoid supports existing MUST_NOT; retain the excessive qualifier rather than prohibiting all peripheral motion. Comfort supports priority2.

statement.en: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when people can play other audio.
statement.ja: 利用者が別のaudioを再生できる場合、environmental soundscapeのvolumeを下げるか停止する。

conditions: People can play other audio while they use the environment.

statement.en: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when people can play other audio in the environment.
statement.ja: 環境内で利用者が別の音声を再生できる場合は、環境音の音量を下げるか、停止する。

conditions: People can play other audio in the custom environment, such as a movie soundtrack.
Lowering the soundscape or stopping it are alternatives; both are not required.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row78, Creating an environment: be sure supports existing conditional MUST. Preserve lower-or-stop and the other-audio context; prioritizing the person's selected audio supports priority3.

statement.en: Provide a ground plane mesh in a custom environment so people feel grounded.
statement.ja: 利用者がgroundedだと感じられるよう、custom environmentにground plane meshを設ける。

statement.en: Always provide a ground-plane mesh in a custom environment so people do not feel as though they are floating.
statement.ja: 独自の環境には常に地面を表すメッシュを設け、利用者が宙に浮いているように感じないようにする。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Row82, Creating an environment: explicit Always supports existing MUST, including the flat-image case; grounding and comfort support priority2.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention

statement.en: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention on content without hiding other experiences.
statement.ja: 他の体験を隠さずcontentへ注意を向けるため、dimmed passthroughを使う。

conditions: Use it in the Shared Space or a Full Space.
Passthrough uses black tint by default and can use a custom tint.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the attention purpose, supported spaces, and default or custom tint behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use mixed immersion for unbounded 3D experiences

statement.en: Use mixed immersion in a Full Space for unbounded 3D content blended with passthrough.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでunbounded 3D contentをpassthroughと組み合わせるにはmixed immersionを使う。

conditions: Mixed immersion has no system-defined movement boundary.
Nearby content becomes semi-opaque when a person approaches a physical object.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the Full Space scope, absent boundary, and automatic physical-object response.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use progressive immersion to blend an environment with surroundings

statement.en: Use progressive immersion when a custom environment should partially replace passthrough.
statement.ja: custom environmentでpassthroughを部分的に置き換える場合はprogressive immersionを使う。

conditions: Support portrait or landscape content where appropriate.
People adjust immersion within a 120–360 degree default range or a specified custom range.
The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded partial replacement, orientation, adjustable range, and movement-boundary context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use full immersion for a fully virtual environment

statement.en: Use full immersion for a 360-degree custom environment that completely replaces passthrough.
statement.ja: passthroughを完全に置き換える360-degree custom environmentにはfull immersionを使う。

conditions: The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary when the experience starts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded complete passthrough replacement and the system-defined movement boundary.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game.
statement.ja: immersive appやgameに複数の利用方法を用意する。

conditions: Support accessibility features people use to personalize interaction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded user choice and accessibility personalization as coequal design constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion

statement.en: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion.
statement.ja: Shared Spaceまたはmixed immersionでの起動を優先する。

conditions: Preserve switching among running experiences.
Let people choose when to increase immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded cross-app switching and user control over increased immersion.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Guide attention to key moments at every immersion level

statement.en: Help people engage with key moments at every level of immersion.
statement.ja: immersion levelにかかわらず、key momentへ利用者の注意を導く。

conditions: Start with subtle cues and strengthen them only for a documented reason.
Cues can include dimming, tinting, motion, scale, and Spatial Audio.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the cue types and subtle-first escalation strategy.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors

statement.en: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors in visionOS 2 and later.
statement.ja: visionOS 2以降ではsubtleなpassthrough tint colorを優先する。

conditions: Coordinate surroundings and visible hands with the experience.
exceptions: Avoid bright or dramatic tints that distract people or reduce immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the version scope, coordination purpose, and distracting-tint restriction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Protect visual comfort in a Full Space

statement.en: Protect people’s visual comfort in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで利用者のvisual comfortを守る。

conditions: Prefer placing 3D content within the field of view.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the general comfort prompt from the explicit comfortable-motion requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Choose immersion that supports expected movement

statement.en: Choose an immersion style that supports the movement people may make.
statement.ja: 利用者が行う可能性のあるmovementに対応するimmersion styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Minor movements include shifting weight, turning, and changing between sitting and standing.
Use mixed immersion when people may move beyond the approximately 1.5-meter boundary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded expected movement and the boundary-dependent mixed-style fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or full immersion

statement.en: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or fully immersive experiences.
statement.ja: progressiveまたはfully immersiveな体験でmovementを求めない。

conditions: Provide interaction methods that work without physical movement.
exceptions: Bring virtual content closer instead of requiring a person to approach it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded disability and physical-space constraints with a no-movement alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Adopt ARKit when blending content with surroundings

statement.en: Adopt ARKit when custom content needs information about a person’s surroundings.
statement.ja: custom contentで利用者の周囲情報が必要な場合はARKitを採用する。

conditions: Use surroundings or hand-position data only for the scoped experience.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the ARKit choice from the explicit permission requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Design smooth, predictable immersion transitions

statement.en: Design smooth, predictable transitions between immersion styles.
statement.ja: immersion style間をsmoothかつpredictableに遷移させる。

conditions: Use gentle transitions that let people visually track changes.
exceptions: Avoid sudden or jarring transitions that can disorient people.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded visual tracking and the disorientation risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Let people choose when to change immersion

statement.en: Let people choose when to enter or exit a more immersive experience.
statement.ja: よりimmersiveな体験へ入る時と出る時を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Provide a clear action for entering and exiting immersion.
exceptions: Avoid requiring system controls to reduce immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded explicit entry and exit actions and the system-control restriction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer familiar virtual-hand characteristics

statement.en: Prefer virtual hands that match familiar positions, gestures, and interactions.
statement.ja: familiarな位置、gesture、interactionに一致するvirtual handsを優先する。

conditions: Support natural interaction and sustained immersion in virtual worlds.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded position and gesture matching as the familiar-characteristics basis.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use caution with oversized virtual hands

statement.en: Use caution when virtual hands are larger than the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: virtual handsを利用者の手より大きくする場合は注意する。

conditions: Avoid obscuring content or making interaction feel clumsy.
Keep virtual hands proportional to the surrounding space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded content visibility, interaction precision, and spatial-proportion risks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Minimize distracting environmental content

statement.en: Minimize environmental content that distracts from the primary task.
statement.ja: primary taskから注意をそらすenvironmental contentを最小限にする。

conditions: Avoid excessive movement and high-contrast detail around primary content.
Use higher-quality assets in important areas and quieter assets elsewhere.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded task focus and the source's quality and dimming hierarchy techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Make environmental objects’ interactivity understandable

statement.en: Help people distinguish interactive objects in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでinteractive objectを判別できるようにする。

conditions: Use object proximity to support expectations about reach and interaction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded proximity as the documented cue for likely interactivity.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Keep environmental animation subtle

statement.en: Keep animation in a custom environment small and gentle.
statement.ja: custom environmentのanimationをsmallかつgentleに保つ。

conditions: Enrich the environment without distracting people or causing discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated subtle-animation guidance from the explicit field-of-view-edge prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Create an expansive custom environment

statement.en: Create an expansive custom environment regardless of the place it depicts.
statement.ja: 描く場所にかかわらずexpansiveなcustom environmentを作る。

conditions: Avoid spatial restriction that can cause discomfort or claustrophobia.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded spatial comfort and claustrophobia as the expansion rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use Spatial Audio to create environmental atmosphere

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to create atmosphere in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentのatmosphereを作るためSpatial Audioを使う。

conditions: Avoid excessive repetition or looping in the soundscape.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated atmospheric audio guidance from the conditional other-audio requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment

statement.en: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentで利用者がgroundedだと感じられるようにする。

conditions: Use a ground plane to provide a stable spatial reference.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the grounding goal from the explicit ground-plane requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Minimize asset redundancy in a custom environment

statement.en: Minimize repeated assets and models in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでassetやmodelの繰り返しを最小限にする。

conditions: Frequent repetition can make an environment feel less realistic.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded realism as the reason to limit repeated assets.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid flat 360-degree images for visionOS environments

statement.en: Avoid using a flat 360-degree image as a visionOS environment.
statement.ja: visionOSのenvironmentには、flatな360-degree画像を使わない。

conditions: Prefer object meshes with lighting and shaders for subtle environmental animation.
exceptions: If a flat 360-degree image is necessary, add a ground-plane mesh to improve realism and grounding.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the scale and immersion limitation, preferred mesh treatment, and ground-plane fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Reserve immersion for meaningful moments and content

statement.en: Reserve immersion for meaningful tasks, moments, and content.
statement.ja: immersionをmeaningfulなtask、moment、contentに限定する。

conditions: Keep tasks in the Shared Space when immersion adds little value.
Let people remain aware of surroundings and other software when appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded task-level proportionality and continued access to surroundings and other software.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid obscuring passthrough in mixed immersion

statement.en: When using mixed immersion, avoid obscuring too much passthrough.
statement.ja: mixed immersionではpassthroughを過度に遮らない。

conditions: Preserve enough physical context for people to understand and navigate their surroundings.
exceptions: Use progressive or full immersion when virtual objects must substantially obscure passthrough.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional AVOID lead and its safer immersion-style alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Indicate an immersive exit control’s purpose

statement.en: Indicate the purpose of an immersive-experience exit control.
statement.ja: immersive experienceのexit controlが何を行うか示す。

conditions: Differentiate reducing immersion from quitting the experience.
exceptions: Before quitting, consider pause or return controls that let people save progress.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the omitted Indicate lead and recorded both possible exit outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Fade virtual hands when hand tracking is interrupted

statement.en: When hand tracking is interrupted, fade virtual hands out and reveal the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: hand trackingが中断したらvirtual handsをfade outし、利用者自身の手を表示する。

conditions: Fade virtual hands back in when tracking returns.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional fade lead and its tracking-return transition.

conditions: Prevent motion from causing distraction, confusion, or discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered explicit comfortable-motion guidance from the supporting paragraph.

conditions: The experience uses ARKit data to blend custom content with a person’s surroundings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit permission requirement from the ARKit supporting paragraph.

conditions: An immersive experience provides an exit control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit outcome-clarity requirement from the exit-control supporting paragraph.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid frozen virtual hands during tracking interruption

statement.en: Avoid leaving virtual hands frozen or unresponsive when hand tracking is interrupted.
statement.ja: hand tracking中断時にvirtual handsをfrozenまたはunresponsiveな状態で残さない。

conditions: Reveal the viewer’s hands while virtual hands are unavailable.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the direct prohibition and kept it at conservative AVOID strength.

conditions: The experience displays animation in a custom environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit field-of-view-edge motion prohibition.

conditions: People can play other audio while they use the environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional soundscape-volume requirement from supporting prose.

conditions: The app or game presents a custom environment in a Full Space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit ground-plane requirement from supporting prose.
